# Md. Sameer Sakib

> Software Engineer & Performance Marketer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh (serving Bangladesh & worldwide). I build fast websites, e-commerce stores, and custom business software (CRM, ERP, HR, POS), configure browser & server-side tracking (Pixel, CAPI, GA4), and manage Meta, Google, and TikTok ad campaigns—all in one place.

## Core Services

### Software & Web Engineering
- **Bespoke Websites & Online Stores:** Custom conversion landing pages, marketing websites, and e-commerce stores (Next.js, Shopify, WordPress).
- **Custom Business Software (Buy Outright or SaaS):** Tailored CRM, ERP, HR, POS, and internal workflow tools.
- **Existing Site Upgrades:** UI improvements, speed optimization, and new feature development without a full rebuild.

### Performance Marketing & Tracking
- **Paid Ads Management:** Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok Ads structured and optimized daily for profitable leads and orders.
- **Server-Side Tracking & Attribution:** Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and Google Analytics 4 setup so ad algorithms receive accurate purchase and lead signals.
- **Creative Testing & Scaling:** Ongoing ad creative iteration, funnel optimization, and weekly performance reporting.
